answer_1.quote: we introduce a strict definition of grounding: a model is truly grounding on given contexts when it (1) uses all essential knowledge from the contexts and (2) strictly adheres to their scope in response generation without hallucinated information.
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses to questions based on provided external contexts

answer_2.quote: We present an automatic metric to measure whether the model grounds well under the definition in Section 3.1.
automatic_metrics: Grounding performance (F1 of atomic fact presence)
